title: Rakta Shodhak Sarbat
description: Rakta Shodhak Sarbat (Blood Purifier Syrup) is a targeted multi-herbal syrup containing powerful blood-cleansing herbs like Neem, Khair, and Manjistha. This classical formulation purifies blood from internal toxins. Cures acne, pimples, and boils. Improves overall skin health and complexion.
dosage: 15–20 ml taken twice daily with an equal amount of water after food
